note: Norfolk Island's bank is a branch of an Australian bank numbered in Australia's own BSB system: AusPayNet's BSB Directory (the full file, read 2026-10-30) lists the Commonwealth Bank's Norfolk Island branch, Taylors Road, Burnt Pine, postcode 2899, at BSB 062-950 (and 762-950), and its key gives CBA as the Commonwealth Bank of Australia, prefixes 06, 16, 17 and 76. So an account there is numbered as one in Australia, a BSB and an account number. The Commonwealth Bank's fee guide (effective October 2026) also names the island's own stamp duty and GST on its services there.
